scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n rust,wasm,web -c yellow,green,cyan "DB=bb1.db ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173 nodemon -q -w src -w core -w Cargo.toml -e rs,toml --signal SIGTERM -x 'cargo run'" "nodemon -q -w core -w wasm/src -w wasm/Cargo.toml -e rs,toml --on-change-only -x 'npm run -s wasm:dev'" "vite"
scripts.dev:fresh: DB=bb1.db cargo run -q -- --drop-db && npm run dev
scripts.dev:peer: npm run -s wasm:dev && concurrently -k -n peer,peerweb -c magenta,blue "DB=bb2.db PORT=8081 ORIGIN=http://localhost:5174 cargo run" "API=http://localhost:8081 vite --port 5174 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:peer:fresh: DB=bb2.db cargo run -q -- --drop-db && npm run dev:peer
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:linux-x64: npm run build && cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
scripts.build:linux-arm64: npm run build && cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
